Subject: Introduction: Felix Arundel and Owen Pritchard
Date: Thursday 8 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Felix Arundel <felix.arundel@fenwicklabs.example.test>, Owen Pritchard <owen.pritchard@oakleyrowe.example.test>

Felix, Owen,

Connecting you both as promised. Felix runs the labs side at Fenwick, Owen is head of data at Oakley Rowe and is looking at the same retrieval problem.

Owen has said he will send Felix the anonymised sample this week, and Felix will come back with a view on feasibility. I will leave you to it.

Best,
Dom
notes: Both undertakings are between two counterparties. Dom owes nothing and is owed nothing.
